description: This file defines a final class 'SimpleFileWatcher' that manages file system event watching, providing start and stop functionalities, wrapping an internal watcher instance.

classes.name: SimpleFileWatcher
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates file system event watching, providing control methods to start and stop monitoring.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SimpleFileWatcher with a CoalescingFSEventsWatcher instance.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializer that stops the watcher upon object deallocation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event watcher.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file system event watcher.
